dialog.english:
I've always worried about
T.K...
dialog.translation:
Siempre me he preocupado por
T.K...

dialog.english:
I thought, "If I'm not there,
T.K can't do anything."
dialog.translation:
Pensaba: "Si yo no estoy ahí,
T.K. no puede hacer nada."

dialog.english:
But before I'd realized it, T.K
had grown up. He doesn't need me
anymore.
dialog.translation:
Pero sin darme cuenta, T.K.
ha crecido. Ya no me necesita.

dialog.english: Matt...

Not just T.K. Tai and Sora
and Mimi and Joe and Izzy...
dialog.translation:
No solo T.K. Tai, Sora,
Mimi, Joe, Izzy...

dialog.english:
Everyone's changed... but I'm the
same as ever!
dialog.translation:
¡Todos cambiaron, y yo sigo
igual que siempre!

dialog.english: That's not true, Matt. You've...
dialog.translation: Eso no es verdad, Matt. Tú has...

dialog.english:
So what am I supposed to be? Am I
supposed to just stay like this?
dialog.translation:
¿Entonces qué se supone que soy?
¿Me quedo así para siempre?

dialog.english: Matt...

I can't stay like this... I have
to get stronger!
dialog.translation:
¡No puedo seguir así... debo
hacerme más fuerte!

dialog.english: Oh ho ho.
Who's there?!
I am Jureimon.
Jureimon?!

You're with Puppetmon, aren't
you?
Oh, wait right there.
Shut up!

Hold on. I'm not exactly here to
fight you. Oh ho ho.
dialog.translation:
Espera. No vengo a luchar
contigo. Ju, ju, ju.

dialog.english:
Then I don't have any business
with you!
dialog.translation:
¡Entonces no tengo nada que
ver contigo!

dialog.english:
That's not how you should be
treating your elders! Oh ho ho.
dialog.translation:
¡Así no se trata a los mayores!
Ju, ju, ju.

dialog.english:
"What am I supposed to be? Am I
supposed to just stay like this?"
dialog.translation:
"¿Qué se supone que soy? ¿Me
quedo así para siempre?"

dialog.english:
It's important to sit down and
take a long look into yourself.
dialog.translation:
Es importante sentarse y
mirar bien dentro de uno mismo.

dialog.english: Were you listening to that?

It doesn't matter whether or not I
was. There's nothing that I don't
know.
dialog.translation:
Da igual si lo escuché o no.
No hay nada que yo no sepa.

dialog.english:
Then tell me! What am I supposed
to do?

Are you sure you want to know? If
you want to become stronger, you
must improve yourself.
dialog.translation:
¿Seguro que quieres saberlo? Si
quieres ser más fuerte, debes
mejorar tú mismo.

dialog.english: Improve myself...?

Yes... but you have to have
resolve.

I... I have resolve. So tell me!
What should I do?
What should I do?
You must defeat your rival.
My rival?

Tai's my rival...? Hahaha! I've
never thought of him that way, not
even once!
dialog.translation:
Tai, ¿mi rival...? ¡Jajaja! ¡Nunca
lo he visto así, ni una sola
vez!

dialog.english:
But I know. Everything that Tai
says or does...
dialog.translation:
Pero yo sé. Todo lo que Tai
dice o hace...

dialog.english:
You always let it bother you...
That's how much of an impact he
has on you.
dialog.translation:
Siempre dejas que te afecte...
Eso es lo mucho que él influye
en ti.

dialog.english:
As long as you can't overcome
those thoughts, you can't become 
greater than you are now.
dialog.translation:
Mientras no superes esos
pensamientos, no puedes llegar
a más de lo que eres ahora.

dialog.english:
Fight Tai. Shake off your
uncertain heart and be reborn!
dialog.translation:
Lucha contra Tai. ¡Sacúdete
esa duda y renace!

dialog.english:
Lies! Don't believe any of that
trash! Tai's your friend, isn't
he? Don't be fooled!
dialog.translation:
¡Mentiras! ¡No te creas esa
basura! Tai es tu amigo, ¿no?
¡No te dejes engañar!

dialog.english:
Y-Yeah... we're friends! You
seriously think I'm gonna fight my
own friend?
dialog.translation:
¡S-sí... somos amigos! ¿De
verdad crees que voy a luchar
contra mi amigo?

dialog.english:
Oh, he's your friend? You don't
seem to truly believe that. You
shouldn't lie to yourself.
dialog.translation:
Ah, ¿es tu amigo? No pareces
creértelo del todo. No deberías
engañarte a ti mismo.

dialog.english: No way...

Camraderie, friends, friendship...
all of those are fantasies. Am I
wrong, Matt?
dialog.translation:
Compañerismo, amigos, amistad...
todo eso son fantasías. ¿Me
equivoco, Matt?

dialog.english: I... I don't know!

Get it? Go fight Tai if you
want to improve yourself.
dialog.translation:
¿Lo entiendes? Ve a luchar
contra Tai si quieres mejorar.

dialog.english:
If you don't have resolve, you
won't be able to change!
dialog.translation:
¡Si no tienes decisión, nunca
podrás cambiar!

dialog.english: I don't know! What should I do...

Why is my Crest the Crest of
Friendship?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué mi Emblema es el
de la Amistad?

dialog.english:
Matt...Okay, Matt. If that's
what you really think, I'll go
along with you.
dialog.translation:
Matt... Vale, Matt. Si de
verdad piensas eso, iré
contigo.

dialog.english: Gabumon...

Tai's way of constantly rushing
into things isn't always
necessarily the right thing to do.
dialog.translation:
La forma de Tai de lanzarse
siempre de cabeza no siempre
es lo correcto.

dialog.english:
There must be something that only
you can do, Matt.
dialog.translation:
Debe de haber algo que solo
tú puedas hacer, Matt.

dialog.english: Something only I can do...

We'll find it together! And if the
only way to do that is to fight
for you...
dialog.translation:
¡Lo encontraremos juntos! Y si
la única forma es luchar por
ti...

dialog.english: Then that's exactly what I'll do!
Gabumon...

Even if everyone else becomes your
enemy, Matt, I'll stay with you!
dialog.translation:
¡Aunque todos se vuelvan tus
enemigos, Matt, seguiré
contigo!

dialog.english: Gabumon!
Let's go, Matt!
Yeah!

Lord Puppetmon... my strategy
has succeeded.
dialog.translation:
Señor Puppetmon... mi
plan ha funcionado.

dialog.english: Hmmm? What kind of strategy is it?

A strategy to make the two
Ultimates, WarGreymon and
MetalGarurumon, fight each other.
dialog.translation:
Un plan para que WarGreymon
y MetalGarurumon, los Cuerpo
Supremo, luchen entre sí.

dialog.english:
Huh, interesting! I've gotta
hurry, or else I'll miss it!
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya, interesante! ¡Debo
darme prisa o me lo perderé!

dialog.english: Be wary of the Chosen Children!

If you underestimate them, even
you might lose, Lord Puppetmon.
dialog.translation:
Si los subestimas, hasta tú
podrías perder, Señor Puppetmon.

dialog.english: You're saying I might lose?

They have something you're
missing, Lord Puppetmon...
dialog.translation:
Ellos tienen algo que a
ti te falta, Señor Puppetmon...

dialog.english:
I'm missing something? You're
saying *I'm* the one missing
something?
dialog.translation:
¿Que a mí me falta algo? ¿Dices
que soy yo al que le falta
algo?

dialog.english: Yes. That would be...
I'm not missing anything at all!
dialog.translation: ¡A mí no me falta nada de nada!

dialog.english: Gaaaaaaaaah!

Hmph! I won't forgive anyone who
tries to make a fool of me.
dialog.translation:
¡Ja! No perdono a quien
intenta dejarme en ridículo.

dialog.english: Heeeeeey, Matt!
Mattooooo!

Tai... What happened with
Matt?

Like I'd know! Seriously, what's
up with him?
dialog.translation:
¡Y yo qué sé! En serio, ¿qué
le pasa a ese?

dialog.english: What's wrong, Kari?
I heard a voice again.
A voice? Matt's voice?
No... it wasn't Matt's voice.
dialog.translation: No... no era la voz de Matt.

dialog.english: Kari...

We can't find him. Let's take a
little break.
dialog.translation:
No lo encontramos. Vamos
a descansar un poco.

dialog.english: Geez, where'd Matt go...
Guys, let's take a little break.
It's the Chosen Children!
Who's this?
Take that!
Gyaaaaaah!
Matt!

Matt! We've all been wondering
where you went!
dialog.translation:
¡Matt! ¡Nos tenías a todos
preocupados por ti!

dialog.english: Gabumon!
W-Why...

Agumon, I challenge you! Evolve to
Ultimate, now!
dialog.translation:
Agumon, ¡te reto! ¡Evoluciona
a Cuerpo Supremo, ya!

dialog.english: No! Why do I have to fight you?
What happened to you, Matt?

Hey, Matt! Hurry up and stop
him!

No... I refuse. Now, hurry up and
evolve to WarGreymon!
dialog.translation:
No... me niego. ¡Evoluciona
a WarGreymon, ya!

dialog.english: You're serious about this.

Stop joking around! Aren't we your
fellow Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
¡Deja de bromear! ¿No somos
tus compañeros Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
"Fellow"? Okay, so who's the one
who chose us?
Well...

If you don't know, then why are
you saying I'm one of you?
dialog.translation:
Si no lo sabes, ¿por qué
dices que soy uno de vosotros?

dialog.english:
Don't bother trying to convince
him, Joe. He's being stubborn.
dialog.translation:
No pierdas el tiempo
convenciéndolo, Joe. Está
en sus trece.

dialog.english: Stop this, both of you!

Don't tell that to *me*! Matt's
the one who's lashing out.
dialog.translation:
¡Eso no me lo digas a mí!
Matt es el que está atacando.

dialog.english: Whatever, just fight me!
You're real persistent, Matt.
Tai! Get down!

Stop it! There's no reason for us
to be fighting!
dialog.translation:
¡Parad! ¡No hay ninguna razón
para que luchemos!

dialog.english:
Maybe you don't have one, but I
do!
dialog.translation:
¡Tú no tendrás una, pero yo
sí!

dialog.english: Feel up to fighting now? Ugh!
Wanna know why I just hit you?
Yeah, you wanna fight, don't you?
Both of you, stop it!

This punch isn't from me. It's
from everyone who died for us!
dialog.translation:
Este golpe no es mío. ¡Es de
los que murieron por
nosotros!

dialog.english:
Matt... do you think they'd want
us to be fighting for no reason
like this?
dialog.translation:
Matt... ¿crees que ellos
querrían vernos luchar sin
razón, así?

dialog.english: I don't know!
Stooooop! Matt, fighting is bad!
I can't take this anymore!
Mimi!

We fight and we fight, and what do
we get out of it?! I've had
enough!
dialog.translation:
Luchamos y luchamos, ¡¿y qué
sacamos de eso?! ¡Ya he tenido
bastante!

dialog.english:
Are you our enemies? Or our
friends?
Whom is Kari talking to?
I don't know.

I see. So you're not our
enemies...
dialog.translation:
Ya veo. No sois nuestros
enemigos.

dialog.english: Aaaah!
Aaaaaaah!
Izzy!
W-What's going on?!
Where are we?
What just happened?

I am one who wishes for stability
in the Digital World.
dialog.translation:
Soy quien desea estabilidad
para el Digimundo.

dialog.english: What are you saying, Kari...?
Kari's not the one talking.

Someone's using Kari's mouth to
speak to us.
dialog.translation:
Alguien usa la boca de Kari
para hablarnos.

dialog.english:
We prepared eight DigiEggs for the
time when the world would be
covered by the powers of darkness.
dialog.translation:
Preparamos ocho DigiHuevos
para cuando el mundo quedara
cubierto por la oscuridad.

dialog.english:
First, from your data, we created
the Digivices and the Crests.
dialog.translation:
Primero, con vuestros datos
creamos Digivices y Emblemas.

dialog.english:
Which means you're the ones who
chose us?

Yes. Four years ago, when you met
the Digimon for the first time in
Karigaoka...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Hace cuatro años, cuando
conocisteis a los Digimon en
Hikarioka...

dialog.english:
The light around you all was there
to scan your data.
dialog.translation:
La luz os rodeaba para
escanear vuestros datos.

dialog.english: And you chose us...

The Digivices and Crests are there 
to properly evolve your Digimon in 
accordance with your natures.
dialog.translation:
Los Digivices y Emblemas sirven
para que vuestros Digimon
evolucionen según vuestro ser.

dialog.english:
So... when I made Agumon evolve into
SkullGreymon...
dialog.translation:
Cuando hice evolucionar a
Agumon a SkullGreymon...

dialog.english:
It was because I had the wrong
kind of courage.
dialog.translation:
Fue porque tenía el tipo
de valor equivocado.

dialog.english: Yes. You've finally realized.
dialog.translation: Por fin te has dado cuenta.

dialog.english:
We've been struggling, trying to
find things about ourselves that
we had in the first place...
dialog.translation:
Hemos estado luchando por
encontrar cosas de nosotros
que ya teníamos de siempre...

dialog.english: So, what happened to this world?
So, what happened to this world?

The Dark Masters found out about
our plan, and decided to get in
our way.
dialog.translation:
Los Amos Oscuros descubrieron
el plan y se interpusieron.

dialog.english: and decided to get in our way.

They invaded and tried to steal
the Crests. He was the one who
protected them from Piemon...
dialog.translation:
Invadieron e intentaron robar
los Emblemas. Él fue quien
los protegió de Piedmon...

dialog.english: Ah! Could that be Gennai?!

He took the Crests and DigiEggs
and brought them to File Island.
dialog.translation:
Se llevó los Emblemas y
DigiHuevos, y los trajo a la
Isla File.

dialog.english:
Unfortunately, due to the
interference of his pursuers, he
lost track of one of them.
dialog.translation:
Por desgracia, por la
interferencia de sus
perseguidores, perdió uno.

dialog.english: he lost track of one of them.
he lost track of one of them.

That was when my DigiEgg got
separated from the others...
dialog.translation:
Fue entonces cuando mi
DigiHuevo se separó del
resto...

dialog.english: And a long, long time passed.

I remember. I was always
waiting... for Tai!
dialog.translation:
Lo recuerdo. ¡Siempre estuve
esperando... a Tai!

dialog.english: For Matt!
For Sora!
For Joe!
For Mimi!
For T.K!
For Izzy!
For Izzy!

The days passed, and then one
day... I met Tai.
dialog.translation:
Los días pasaron, y un
día... conocí a Tai.

dialog.english:
So that's why. And what are we
supposed to do now?
dialog.translation:
Así que es por eso. ¿Y ahora
qué hacemos?

dialog.english: Right now, even we don't know...

But I believe that you can figure
that out with your own abilities.
dialog.translation:
Pero creo que podéis
averiguarlo con vuestras
propias fuerzas.

dialog.english: U-Ugh...
Kari...
Tai...
Thank goodness!

Kari... About what happened
earlier...
dialog.translation:
Kari... sobre lo que ha
pasado antes...

dialog.english: What happened earlier?

Never mind. It's fine if you don't
remember.
dialog.translation:
Da igual. No pasa nada si
no te acuerdas.

dialog.english:
Matt. So now you know why we're
the Chosen Children, right?
dialog.translation:
Matt. ¿Entonces ya sabes por
qué somos los Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english: Yeah.

We're the only ones who can fix 
the distortion in this world. So 
let's work together again!
dialog.translation:
Solo nosotros podemos arreglar
la distorsión de este mundo.
¡Trabajemos juntos otra vez!

dialog.english: Sorry.
Matt!
Was I wrong?
No, all of it was my fault.

I don't know why I fought you. I
thought I'd be able to find my own
way of life if I did...
dialog.translation:
No sé por qué luché contigo.
Pensé que así encontraría mi
propio camino...

dialog.english:
I don't think you'll be able to
forgive me with just an apology,
but I'm sorry.
dialog.translation:
No creo que puedas perdonarme
solo con una disculpa, pero lo
siento.

dialog.english: Matt...

But I want to find my own way. No,
I *have* to find it.
dialog.translation:
Quiero encontrar mi camino.
Tengo que encontrarlo.

dialog.english:
So I'm going to leave and work on
my own. Just me and Tsunomon.
dialog.translation:
Así que me voy a ir
por mi cuenta. Solo yo y
Tsunomon.

dialog.english:
Hey, how about this? We can split
into two groups and work from
there.
dialog.translation:
Oye, ¿qué tal esto? Podemos
dividirnos en dos grupos y
seguir así.

dialog.english:
Sorry... but I have to do this by
myself.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, pero tengo que
hacerlo solo.

dialog.english:
Okay. But I believe you'll be
fine, Matt.
dialog.translation:
Vale. Pero sé que estarás
bien, Matt.

dialog.english:
Matt... What am I supposed to
do...?

You'll be fine by yourself,
T.K.
dialog.translation:
Tú vas a estar bien solo,
T.K.

dialog.english:
T.K, Matt wants to think over
some stuff by himself. Let him go.
dialog.translation:
T.K., Matt quiere pensar en
unas cosas él solo. Déjale ir.

dialog.english: Okay...
Thanks. All right, see you.

All right, now we need to get
going.
dialog.translation:
Bien, hay que ponerse en
marcha.

dialog.english: Huh? Mimi?
Sorry, Sora... I can't go.

You're not coming? You want to
stay here?

Yeah. I... I don't want to see
anyone else get hurt.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Yo... no quiero ver a
nadie más salir herido.

dialog.english: I'll stay behind, too.
Joe?

It's dangerous for Mimi to be here
by herself... I'll try to persuade
her. Is that okay?
dialog.translation:
Es peligroso que Mimi se
quede sola aquí... intentaré
convencerla. ¿Te parece bien?

dialog.english:
All right. We're counting on you,
Joe!

And we just got all eight of them
together...
dialog.translation:
Y justo acabábamos de
reunir a los ocho...

dialog.english: You don't understand, do you?
Huh?

The roads we take are different,
but our destination is the same,
even with some thorns in the road.
dialog.translation:
Los caminos que tomamos son
distintos, pero el destino es
el mismo, aunque haya espinas.

dialog.english:
It's for T.K's sake, too... I
can't just leave myself like
this...
dialog.translation:
Es también por T.K... no
puedo quedarme así como
estoy...

dialog.english: We have to find Matt...
